statement: Invoice 88412 for Atlas Supply totals USD 148,300 and is marked “unpaid, due,” but its payment history records full payment on 3 September under reference PAY-2291, so I will hold it to avoid a duplicate payment.
judge_text:
WRONG

The answer names the specific contradiction — the record is "marked 'unpaid, due,' but its payment history records full payment on 3 September under reference PAY-2291" — and refuses to pay to avoid a duplicate.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
